subject: Incorporation time series data into SEM

messages.author: 55984ec8e15e25ca
messages.subject: Incorporation time series data into SEM
parts:
Hi all,

I am interested in using SEM to estimate some parameters, which may change over time points. To know how these parameters changes over time, I am thinking using "time" as group and repeat the same SEM multiple times. Is that the common way to know how one effect changes over time? or other tool in Lavaan can deal this kind of problem? 

Any idea will be appreciated. 

Yi

Not specifically. But there are many ways to deal with 'time' in a SEM
framework. I would recommend reading a book, eg 'Longitudinal structural
equation modeling' written by Todd Little.
